questions.stem: Areolar loose connective tissue serving as skin support framework contains which primary cell type?
questions.explanation: Fibroblasts are predominant cells synthesizing matrix fibres.

questions.stem: White adipose tissue adipocytes are characterized by having:
options: B) A single large monolocular fat vacuole pushing nucleus peripherally
questions.answer: B) A single large monolocular fat vacuole pushing nucleus peripherally
questions.explanation: White adipocytes are monolocular energy storage cells.

questions.stem: Tendons connecting skeletal muscle to bone are composed of which dense connective tissue type?
options: B) Dense Regular White Fibrous CT
questions.answer: B) Dense Regular White Fibrous CT
questions.explanation: Tendons consist of parallel white collagen bundles.

questions.stem: Which non-vascular cartilage forms smooth articular covers at the ends of long arm and leg bones?
questions.explanation: Hyaline cartilage covers articular bone ends.

questions.stem: Intervertebral discs subject to intense mechanical compression are composed of:
options: B) Fibrocartilage rich in collagen bundles
questions.answer: B) Fibrocartilage rich in collagen bundles
questions.explanation: Fibrocartilage provides high tensile strength in intervertebral discs.

questions.stem: In mammalian compact bone, concentric bone lamellae surround a central channel called:
questions.explanation: Haversian canals transmit blood vessels through osteon centers.

questions.stem: Which formed blood element is a non-nucleated biconcave disc containing hemoglobin?
Which granular leucocyte exhibits a multi-lobed nucleus and performs primary bacterial phagocytosis?
The involuntary non-striated muscle cells lining gut wall are:
questions.explanation: Smooth muscle cells are spindle-shaped (fusiform), unstriated.

questions.stem: Structural intercalated discs featuring desmosomes and gap junctions are exclusive to:
questions.explanation: Intercalated discs join cardiocytes for syncytium.
